svg.title: Canada · APEC 1997 military CANADA plate · 180
svg.desc: Reconstruction from BCpl8s photographs: layout proportions, paint colours and dies are approximate; validation checks the documented serial format, not a real registration. Size assumed 300 × 150 mm; the APEC sticker is simplified. Shared national CANADA shell; this photographed variant omits maple leaves.

g.title: APEC historical striped globe — editable reference reconstruction
g.desc: Original native coastline, globe, grid, and letter outlines recovered from the official December 2006 APEC at a Glance cover. Proportions, palette, grid line weight, and dense horizontal halo adapted to match the supplied int-apeco.gif. No tracing, embedded images, external assets, or fonts. The canvas outside the oval is transparent; internal white details are opaque.
